description: This is the main server source file for a Node.js/Express backend. It sets up middleware for security, CORS, logging, rate limiting, defines a health check route, mounts route handlers for authentication, users, and metrics, handles errors and 404s, and initializes Socket.IO for real-time communication. It also connects to the database and ensures a default admin user.

classes.name: SocketIOServer
classes.description: The Socket.IO server class, used here to enable real-time communication over websockets.

methods.name: bootstrap()
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that sets up and starts the Express server with associated middleware, socket.io, database connection, and admin user initialization.
